paragraphs: The Irish Government wants to change an important law. The law is called the triple lock.
Right now, Irish soldiers can only go abroad on peace missions with three yes votes. The Government, the Dáil and the UN Security Council must all agree.
The Government wants to remove the UN Security Council part. It says one big country can stop a mission too easily.
Now the Government plans a small change to its new law. Ministers will have to think about votes at the UN General Assembly.

On Saturday, thousands of people marched in Dublin. They walked to Leinster House, where the Dáil meets. Many opposition parties joined them. They say the plan is bad for Irish neutrality. The Government says this is not true.
The Government wants the new law to pass before the end of the year.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭政府想要修改一項重要的法律。
這項法律被稱為「三重鎖」。
目前，愛爾蘭士兵只有在獲得三項同意後，才能出國執行和平任務。
政府、眾議院和聯合國安理會都必須同意。
政府想要刪除聯合國安理會這一部分。
政府表示，一個大國太容易就能阻止一項任務。
現在政府計畫對新法案做一點小修改。
部長們將必須考慮聯合國大會的投票結果。
星期六，數千人在都柏林遊行。
他們走到眾議院開會的倫斯特宮。
許多反對黨也加入了他們。
他們說這項計畫對愛爾蘭的中立不利。
政府說事實並非如此。
政府希望新法在年底前通過。

paragraphs: The Government plans to change its triple lock bill after thousands of people marched in Dublin to protect Irish neutrality. Under the change, ministers would have to consider any vote by the UN General Assembly before they send troops abroad.

At the moment, the triple lock means that 12 or more members of the Defence Forces can only go on a peacekeeping mission if three groups agree. These are the Government, the Dáil and the UN Security Council. The Government wants to remove the Security Council step. It says the council does not work well, because any one of its five permanent members can block a mission.

Defence and Foreign Affairs Minister Helen McEntee has been allowed to write the new amendment. It is similar to an idea from ten Fianna Fáil TDs, including former defence minister Willie O'Dea. However, Fine Gael sources say the change is not a reply to that group.

On Saturday afternoon, thousands of people walked from the Garden of Remembrance to Leinster House. The march was organised by the Irish Neutrality League. Sinn Féin, Labour, the Social Democrats, People Before Profit-Solidarity, the Greens and Aontú all took part. They say the plan puts neutrality at risk, but the Government disagrees.
Opposition parties want a stronger rule. In their view, troops should only go abroad if the General Assembly clearly approves the mission.
More than 200 amendments have been put forward. The bill goes to the Oireachtas defence committee next week, and the Government hopes it will become law by the end of the year.
sentZh: 數千人在都柏林遊行捍衛愛爾蘭中立後，政府計畫修改其三重鎖法案。
根據這項修改，部長們在派兵出國前，必須考慮聯合國大會的任何投票。
目前，三重鎖意味著12名以上的國防軍成員只有在三方都同意時，才能參加維和任務。
這三方是政府、眾議院和聯合國安理會。
政府想要取消安理會這一步驟。
政府表示安理會運作不良，因為五個常任理事國中任何一國都能阻擋任務。
國防兼外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂已獲准起草這項新修正案。
它與包括前國防部長威利・歐戴在內的十位共和黨眾議員提出的想法相似。
不過，統一黨消息人士表示，這項修改並不是對那群人的回應。
星期六下午，數千人從紀念花園步行到倫斯特宮。
這場遊行由愛爾蘭中立聯盟主辦。
新芬黨、工黨、社會民主黨、人民先於利潤—團結黨、綠黨和統一愛爾蘭黨都參加了。
他們說這項計畫讓中立陷入危險，但政府不同意。
反對黨希望有更嚴格的規定。
他們認為，只有在聯合國大會明確批准任務時，部隊才應出國。
已有超過200項修正案被提出。
法案下週將送交國會國防委員會，政府希望它在年底前成為法律。

paragraphs: The Government is preparing to amend its controversial triple lock legislation, just as thousands of protesters marched through Dublin in defence of Irish neutrality. The change would require ministers to consider any resolution passed by the UN General Assembly before approving an overseas deployment.

Under the current system, sending 12 or more Defence Forces personnel on a peacekeeping mission requires approval from the Government, the Dáil and the UN Security Council. The Government describes the Security Council as dysfunctional, since any of its five permanent members can veto a mission, and it wants to remove that requirement.

Defence and Foreign Affairs Minister Helen McEntee has reportedly been given permission to draft the amendment following a meeting with the Taoiseach, the Tánaiste and Independent TD Seán Canney. The proposal closely resembles one tabled by ten Fianna Fáil backbenchers, led by former defence minister Willie O'Dea, although Fine Gael sources insist it is not a response to them.

On Saturday, demonstrators gathered at the Garden of Remembrance before marching to Leinster House. The rally, organised by the Irish Neutrality League, was supported by Sinn Féin, Labour, the Social Democrats, People Before Profit-Solidarity, the Greens and Aontú. Critics argue the plan threatens neutrality, a claim the Government firmly rejects.
Opposition parties are calling for a tougher legal test, under which troops could only be deployed if the General Assembly specifically endorsed the mission.

Around 224 amendments have been tabled to the Defence Amendment Bill 2026. The bill will be examined by the Oireachtas defence committee next week, and the Government aims to have it signed into law before the end of the year.
sentZh: 就在數千名抗議者走上都柏林街頭捍衛愛爾蘭中立之際，政府正準備修改其具爭議性的三重鎖立法。
這項修改將要求部長們在批准海外部署前，考慮聯合國大會通過的任何決議。
在現行制度下，派遣12名以上國防軍人員執行維和任務，需要政府、眾議院和聯合國安理會的批准。
政府形容安理會功能失調，因為五個常任理事國中任何一國都能否決任務，因此希望取消這項要求。
據報導，國防兼外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂在與總理、副總理及無黨籍眾議員肖恩・坎尼開會後，獲准起草這項修正案。
這項提案與前國防部長威利・歐戴帶領的十位共和黨後座議員提出的修正案十分相似，儘管統一黨消息人士堅稱這不是對他們的回應。
星期六，示威者先在紀念花園集結，再遊行到倫斯特宮。
這場由愛爾蘭中立聯盟主辦的集會，獲得新芬黨、工黨、社會民主黨、人民先於利潤—團結黨、綠黨和統一愛爾蘭黨的支持。
批評者認為這項計畫威脅中立，政府則堅決否認這種說法。
反對黨呼籲設立更嚴格的法律標準，即只有在聯合國大會明確支持任務時，才能部署部隊。
《2026年國防修正法案》已有約224項修正案被提出。
該法案下週將由國會國防委員會審查，政府的目標是在年底前讓它簽署成為法律。

paragraphs: The Government is poised to revise its contentious triple lock legislation, even as thousands of protesters took to the streets of Dublin to defend Ireland's long-standing neutrality. Under the planned amendment, ministers would be obliged to take account of any UN General Assembly resolution before sanctioning an overseas deployment.

At present, dispatching 12 or more Defence Forces personnel on peacekeeping duty hinges on the consent of the Government, the Dáil and the UN Security Council. Ministers contend that the Security Council has become dysfunctional, as any one of its five permanent members can thwart a mission at will, and they intend to scrap that element.

Defence and Foreign Affairs Minister Helen McEntee has reportedly been given the green light to draft the clause after talks with the Taoiseach, the Tánaiste and Independent TD Seán Canney. It bears a striking resemblance to a motion tabled by ten Fianna Fáil backbenchers under former defence minister Willie O'Dea, though Fine Gael sources maintain the move is no concession to them.

On Saturday, demonstrators assembled at the Garden of Remembrance and marched on Leinster House. The rally, staged by the Irish Neutrality League, drew backing from Sinn Féin, Labour, the Social Democrats, People Before Profit-Solidarity, the Greens and Aontú. Opponents claim the reform would erode neutrality, an assertion the Government flatly dismisses.
The opposition is pressing for a more stringent legal threshold, whereby troops could be deployed only with the explicit endorsement of the General Assembly.

Some 224 amendments have been lodged to the Defence Amendment Bill 2026. The bill comes before the Oireachtas defence committee next week, with the Government determined to see it enacted by the year's end.
sentZh: 就在數千名抗議者走上都柏林街頭捍衛愛爾蘭長期中立之際，政府已準備修訂其具爭議的三重鎖立法。
根據擬議的修正案，部長們在批准海外部署前，有義務考量聯合國大會的任何決議。
目前，派遣12名以上國防軍人員執行維和任務，取決於政府、眾議院和聯合國安理會的同意。
部長們主張安理會已功能失調，因為五個常任理事國中任何一國都能隨意阻撓任務，因此打算廢除這一環節。
據報導，國防兼外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂在與總理、副總理及無黨籍眾議員肖恩・坎尼會談後，獲准起草這一條款。
它與前國防部長威利・歐戴領導的十位共和黨後座議員提出的動議驚人地相似，不過統一黨消息人士堅稱此舉並非對他們讓步。
星期六，示威者在紀念花園集結，並向倫斯特宮遊行。
這場由愛爾蘭中立聯盟舉辦的集會，獲得新芬黨、工黨、社會民主黨、人民先於利潤—團結黨、綠黨和統一愛爾蘭黨的支持。
反對者聲稱這項改革會侵蝕中立，政府對此說法斷然駁斥。
反對派正力推更嚴格的法律門檻，即只有在聯合國大會明確背書下才能部署部隊。
《2026年國防修正法案》已收到約224項修正案。
該法案下週將提交國會國防委員會，政府決心在年底前使其立法通過。

paragraphs: The Government intends to modify its contentious triple lock legislation, a development that coincides with a substantial demonstration in Dublin in support of Irish neutrality. Under the proposed amendment, ministers would be required to take into consideration any relevant UN General Assembly resolution prior to authorising an overseas deployment.

At present, the deployment of 12 or more Defence Forces personnel on peacekeeping operations is contingent upon the approval of the Government, the Dáil and the UN Security Council. The Government maintains that the Security Council is fundamentally dysfunctional, since any of its five permanent members may unilaterally obstruct a mission; consequently, it seeks to abolish this requirement.

The provision is broadly comparable to an amendment proposed by ten Fianna Fáil backbenchers under former defence minister Willie O'Dea; nevertheless, Fine Gael sources assert that it does not constitute a response to that initiative.

Critics contend that the reform would undermine neutrality, whereas the Government categorically rejects this interpretation.
Opposition parties advocate a more rigorous legal criterion, according to which troops could be deployed only if the General Assembly explicitly endorsed the specific mission.

Approximately 224 amendments have been submitted to the Defence Amendment Bill 2026. The bill will be scrutinised by the Oireachtas defence committee next week, and the Government aspires to enact it before the end of the year.
